notes.title: "Paper Bride 5 Two Lifetimes" steam version is now available!
notes.notes:
"Paper Bride 5 Two Lifetimes" steam version is now available with a 10% discount for the first week!

Life is like a play. Who is an actor? Who is the audience? Who is writing behind the scenes?
 If this is a comedy, why is my laughter full of tears?
If this is a tragedy, why is there no end?

Steam FAQ

  1.What is the price? Will there be in-app purchases?
A:Due to the different exchange rates in different regions, please go to the store to check the specific price~~ Also , there is a 10% discount for the first week of sale!
At the same time, there will also be a special offer for the Paper Bride bundle, with a 20% discount for the first week~

 Paper Bride 5 on Steam will have no in-app purchases or advertisements.
Thank you for your love and support for the paper bride series.


2.When is the release date?
 A: It will be released globally at 10:00 on Dec.1st, Beijing time.
 (If there is an abnormality on the Steam platform, the sale may be delayed)

3.What are the features of the Steam version?
 A: In addition to the well-known horizontal version of the scene, the high-definition restoration of the internal details of the Fulu Chengnan Grand Theater also has more heart-pounding details and motion effects, greatly increasing the immersive puzzle-solving experience; as for the achievements of this version, it is even more interesting.  We believe that everyone will suddenly smile when they achieve these interesting achievements~~

4.How many DLCs does the game have in Paper Bride 5? How do I get it?
 A: There are two DLCs this time, original sound collection and original painting collection, which can be unlocked by purchasing the main game.
Paper Bride 5 Original  Setting: Contains Paper Bride 5 characters, scene-setting drafts and dozens of exquisite 4K original promotional paintings.
The original soundtrack collection includes two OSTs.

5.How long is the overall game?
 A: The current full version of the game is about 3-5 hours long. (Compared to the previous works, the overall duration and difficulty have increased !Have a good time!)

6.Are there any hints for the puzzle? What should I do if the mini-game is too hard to do?
 A: It contains intimate tips, and the mini-game also has a skip function, all of which have a certain CD. Please don't worry~

7.What language versions are currently available?
 A: Currently, there are simplified Chinese, traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese versions. Please enjoy the Chinese folk customs!
